html: † פִּי־בֶ֫סֶת n.pr.loc. in Egypt (Pabast, EbGS 495, or Per-Basted, Griffith Hastings DB iii. 874, ‘House of Bast(et)’ orig. Pĕi-wbaste according to SteindBAS i. 350 cf. NavilleBubastis 44, 46, 48, 56, Gk. Βούβαστις (Herod.), Βούβαστος (Diod Sic.));—Ez 30:17 𝔊 Βουβάστου (genit.), mod. Tel-Basṭa, near Zaḳaziḳ, c. 30 miles NNE. from Cairo.—Vid. Herod. ii. 59 f., 67, 137 f., 166 Diod. xvi. 49, 51 Navillel.c.; Trans. Vict. Inst. xxiii. 137 ff.
